sense: jacket and trousers of the same cloth

terms.comment: Classically a matching set of clothes (Dig. 34.2.39; Mart. 2.46.4) and above all the light gown worn at dinner and at the Saturnalia (Mart. 5.79.2; Lewis & Short). The sense of a jacket and trousers is Traupman’s and Morgan-Owens’s.

phrases.english: This suit looks good on you.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 118, 387, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
Morgan–Owens: Adumbratio, s.v. suit (clothes).
